description_expanded: ABOUT BREAKERS & WAVES: Welcome to Breakers and Waves, ideally situated in the heart of historic Seaside. This property boasts a prime location just a block away from the beach access, in close proximity to the community pools, and merely a few blocks from the town center. With four bikes included in your reservation, you can leisurely explore Seaside's charming shops, delectable restaurants, and the picturesque 30A area by foot or bike. The combined accommodation of the main house and carriage house comfortably sleeps up to 17 guests. The main house features 6 bedrooms and a loft, while the carriage house offers one bedroom and a living room with a sleeper sofa. Unwind in true "Old Florida" style on the screened-in front porch or the back deck, both perfect spots for enjoying your morning coffee or evening beverage as you soak in the ambiance of the day. Breakers and its Carriage House is an exceptional rental property for those seeking a home-like environment, relaxation, and easy access to the vibrant local entertainment scene. ABOUT THE AREA: Seaside Beach, located along the emerald shores of the Gulf of Mexico in the Florida Panhandle, is a renowned coastal community known for its idyllic white sand beaches, charming pastel-colored beachfront homes, and picturesque town center. Developed in the 1980s as a master-planned community, Seaside is often credited as a pioneering example of New Urbanism in architecture and town design. The beach at Seaside is a pristine stretch of soft white sand lapped by the turquoise waters of the Gulf, creating a serene and inviting setting for beachgoers of all ages. Visitors can relax on the beach, swim in the crystal-clear waters, build sandcastles, and enjoy various water activities such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and snorkeling. One of the distinctive features of Seaside Beach is its iconic pastel-colored beach cottages and vacation rental homes, each featuring unique architectural styles that contribute to the community's character and charm. These charming homes create a postcard-perfect backdrop for leisurely strolls along the beach or through the town center. In addition to its natural beauty, Seaside Beach offers a vibrant town center with quaint shops, boutique galleries, gourmet restaurants, food trucks, and lively open-air markets. The central square serves as a gathering place for community events, concerts, outdoor movie nights, and festivals, creating a lively and engaging atmosphere for residents and visitors alike. Seaside Beach is also known for its pedestrian-friendly design, with tree-lined streets, bike paths, and walkable neighborhoods that encourage outdoor activities and social interactions. The community's commitment to sustainable and environmentally conscious practices further enhances its appeal as a destination that values both natural beauty and thoughtful development. Overall, Seaside Beach embodies a harmonious blend of coastal beauty, architectural innovation, and community spirit, making it a beloved destination for those seeking a quintessential beach escape on the shores of the Gulf of Mexico. BEACH ACCESS: * Seaside Private Beach Access PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Access is included to Seaside Swim and Tennis Club with its private tennis courts, 3 swimming pools, and playgrounds. * Includes Swim and Fitness Passes (3 pools, heated in the cooler months) * Short walk to the beach * Private Beach * 4 bikes included * 6 beach towels PARKING: * Free Parking up to 3 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * All reservations are final and there are no refunds for any reason. Please inquire about or purchase travel insurance when booking your vacation with Paradise Properties * The rental agreement has to be signed within 48 hours of booking to secure your reservation. DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle, with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties, and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build lasting memories for all our guests.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
